events.title: Tech Rebound May Boost South Korea Shares
events.description: The South Korea stock market has finished higher in back-to-back sessions, gathering more than 210 points or 3.6 percent along the way. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 5,770-point plateau and it may extend its gains on Tuesday.

events.title: PBoC Loan Rate Due On Tuesday
events.description: The People's Bank of China will on Tuesday announce its loan prime rate for October, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. The rate is expected to hold steady at 3.50 percent.

events.title: Inflation Surge Weighs On Canadian Markets; Index Falls 0.7%
events.description: Canada's S&P/TSX Composite Index declined 252.27 points to 35,924.32 Monday as headline inflation accelerated to 3.1% in September. Geopolitical tensions and central bank monetary policy expectations pressured sentiment across utilities, industrials, and financials.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Marginally Lower
events.description: The Switzerland market's benchmark SMI ended marginally down on Monday after moving in a tight range, as weakness in other European markets amid growing civil unrest in France and tensions in other parts of Europe, as well as the ongoing Russia-Ukraine tensions and Middle East woes rendered the mood cautious.

events.title: European Stocks Fall Amid France Riots, Russia-Ukraine Tensions
events.description: European equities declined Monday as violent unrest in France, escalating Russia-Ukraine tensions, and Middle East concerns weighed on investor sentiment. The pan-European Stoxx 600 fell 0.8%, with major indices across the region posting losses.

events.title: U.S. Housing Market Index Drops To Fourteen-Year Low In October
events.description: A report released by the National Association of Home Builders on Monday showed a bigger-than-expected deterioration in U.S. homebuilder sentiment in the month of October. The report said the NAHB/Wells Fargo housing market index fell to 29 in October from 32 in September. Economists had expected the index to edge down to 31.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Set For Mixed Open; Inflation Data Due
events.description: Canadian stocks are seen opening on a mixed note Monday morning, tracking mixed trend in commodity prices and weak European markets. September inflation data due 8:30 AM ET, following August's unchanged 3% rate. Nasdaq futures signal technology strength as geopolitical concerns weigh on global sentiment.

events.title: FTSE 100 Down 1.05% As Banks, Miners Lead Retreat On Tensions
events.description: U.K. stocks retreated on Monday with the FTSE 100 down 1.05% to 10,767.86 as investors grew wary ahead of jobs reports, inflation data, and retail sales figures this week. European civil unrest and international tensions pressured markets.

events.title: CAC 40 Down Nearly 1.5% As Stocks Tumble Amid Growing Civil Unrest%
events.description: France's benchmark CAC 40 index dropped 1.49% Monday as civil unrest and Middle East tensions drove broad selling across sectors. Major stocks including Stellantis, Accor, and Airbus declined significantly.

events.title: German DAX Falls 1.27% Amid France Unrest, Ukraine Conflict
events.description: German stocks declined Monday as geopolitical tensions escalated across Europe. The DAX benchmark dropped 322.30 points to 25,300.31, pressured by civil unrest in France, Ukrainian military operations in Russia, and Middle East conflict concerns.

events.title: Indian Shares Tumble; Private Banks And Financials Lead Sell-off
events.description: Indian shares fell sharply on Monday due to concerns over persistent foreign investor outflows and elevated crude oil prices in international markets.

events.title: Gold Edges Up As Oil Prices, Yields Dip
events.description: Gold edged up slightly on Monday due to diminishing market expectations for an October Federal Reserve interest rate hike.
